Goodbye Latin America, next stop USA!
In this video, I leave Santiago, Chile, and fly with Avianca to Texas, USA, with a connecting flight through Bogotá, Colombia. This journey marks the end of my Latin America series, and leaving feels different after everything I have experienced here.
It all started in Colombia, followed by Peru, Bolivia, and Chile. From meeting people and trying to communicate in a different language to crossing borders and exploring landscapes that barely looked real, this journey gave me experiences I will remember for a long time.
